regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (single calendar, no regional titles or locator map)
regions.notes: Many edges sit exactly at mid-month and were counted under the at-least-half rule: Long Rains start mid-Feb; Short Rains start mid-Sep; Season A harvest runs mid-Dec to mid-Feb; Season B harvest and Season C marshland planting run mid-Jun to end-Jul; Main Lean box runs mid-Oct to mid-Dec. Season C is a dry-season marshland crop (no rainy shading).

assign.method: Single national calendar, so every province maps to national.

transcriber_notes: January is shaded blue as a separate column with no label; it joins the Short Rains shading across the year edge, so Short Rains is recorded as Sep-Jan. The Season A harvest bar is drawn in two pieces: a Dec piece labelled 'SsnA' and an unlabelled Jan-mid-Feb piece; treated as one harvest (12-2). Main Lean box measured at ~46% of Oct and ~49-52% of Dec (drawn mid-Oct to mid-Dec); both half months were counted, giving 10-12. If strict >50% is wanted it would be Nov only (11-11) or Nov-Dec.
